⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦ニュース→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{俄然|がぜん}⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧きた。
examples.english: That news suddenly made me feel motivated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{証拠|しょうこ}→証拠：10575_shouko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{俄然|がぜん}⟦{活気|かっき}→活気：02554_kakki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びた→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧。
examples.english: New evidence was found, and the investigation suddenly picked up momentum.

notes:
An adverb indicating a sudden and dramatic change, typically for the better or toward greater intensity. Unlike ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧, which simply marks an abrupt event, {俄然|がぜん} implies that a situation has transformed noticeably and often carries a sense of heightened energy or interest.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {俄然|がぜん}⟦やる{気|き}→やる気：05089_yaruki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: suddenly feel motivated
- {俄然|がぜん}⟦{面白|おもしろ}く→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: suddenly become interesting
- {俄然|がぜん}⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: suddenly attract attention
- {俄然|がぜん}⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: suddenly become advantageous

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: suddenly — neutral, marks any abrupt event
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: suddenly, quickly — more colloquial
- にわか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: suddenly — literary, often implies an unexpected shift
